title: データアナリティックス入門
subtitle: Introduction to Data Analytics
educationalGoal: In this course, students will: (1) acquire a basic knowledge of data analytics. (2) learn how to collect, aggregate, and visualize data based on questionnaire surveys. (3) learn how to use statistical methods of sampling.
advice: To analyze data properly, the following four abilities are required: 1. The ability to collect data according to purpose and hypothesized issues. 2. The ability to aggregate data in a table according to the data format. 3. The ability to display data visually using graphs. 4. The ability to verify hypotheses with statistical methods. Students will acquire abilities 1 to 3 mainly through the questionnaire survey exercises in the first half of the course; ability 4 will be learned through exercises using sample data in the second half of the course.
books: Textbook : 統計学〈1〉データ分析の基礎 オフィシャルスタディノート 改定第2版(Japanese book) Reference book : 図解入門ビジネスアンケート調査とデータ解析の仕組みがよ~くわかる本[第2版](Japanese book) Reserved book : アンケート調査入門―失敗しない顧客情報の読み方・まとめ方(Japanese book)
requiredKnowledge: Understanding the meaning of the average, variance, and standard deviation formulas, scatter plots, and correlation coefficients learned in high school mathematics.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the concept of data analytics.
Be able to plan a questionnaire survey.
Be able to create and improve a questionnaire sheet.
Be able to use simple/cross-tabulation to analyze questionnaire results.
Be able to be to produce pie, bar, and scatter charts using Excel.
Be able to test a hypothesis using confidence intervals and various hypothesis testing methods.
